STRATEGY_1.name: Trend Pullback Continuation
scoring_logic: Increase confidence as |structureState| increases.
Increase confidence as EMA50_slope_30m aligns with structureState.
Highest confidence when pullbackRatio is near 0.4–0.6.
Confidence decreases as pullbackRatio moves above 0.8 or below 0.2.
Favor when marketRegime leans TREND.
Reduce confidence if sweepScore meaningfully dominates environment.
Reduce confidence if breakoutScore + high acceptanceTime suggests expansion.

STRATEGY_2.name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal
scoring_logic: Increase confidence as |sweepScore| increases.
Increase confidence when sweepScore meaningfully exceeds breakoutScore.
Increase confidence when acceptanceTime is very low (strong rejection).
Decrease confidence as acceptanceTime rises.
Increase confidence when sweep is recent (small sweepBarsAgo).
Reduce confidence if strong structure continuation opposes reversal.
Favor NY session and overlap periods.

STRATEGY_3.name: Session Breakout Expansion
scoring_logic: Increase confidence as |breakoutScore| increases.
Increase confidence when breakoutScore exceeds sweepScore.
Increase confidence as acceptanceTime rises (sustained acceptance).
Decrease confidence if acceptanceTime remains low.
Favor early London and NY open.
Increase confidence when regime leans EXPANSION.
Boost confidence when breakout aligns with structure direction.

STRATEGY_4.name: Controlled Range Participation
scoring_logic: Increase confidence when both breakoutScore and sweepScore are small relative to other signals.
Increase confidence when structureState is near zero.
Increase confidence when EMA slope is weak.
Favor RANGE regime.
Increase confidence when price is near session extremes.
Reduce confidence when directional or event-driven dominance is visible.

decision_framework: Compute relative confidence for each strategy based on signal alignment.
Compare weighted dominance rather than binary thresholds.
Select strategy with highest probabilistic alignment.
If all confidence levels are weak or conflicting, output WAIT.
Dominance hierarchy is dynamic, not fixed.
